sources.summary: 25 years of big ideas. Now it's your turn. The International Design Contest —Manufacturing the Future— is still open, and there's still time to participate. DEADLINE: SEPTEMBER 16, 2026 This edition presents a unique challenge: design a seat and/or a table that reimagines what furniture can be — sustainable, innovative, built for the world we want to create. Your prototype could be the winning one. Sign up now! A jury of leading design professionals will evaluate all submissions: • Pradyumna Vyas — President, World Design Organization (WDO) • Annamaria Anderloni — Architect at Foster & Partners • Álvaro Matías — Director, Madrid Design Festival • Natalia Zubizarreta — Interior
